entities.name: Vile Cauldron
entities.description: Large metal cauldron of green bubbling liquid that boils down the essence of whatever is put within it.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: Original owner who gave the cauldron to Agatha and later got it back.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: Witch who received the cauldron, enchanted Peter and was boiled alive by Kellan.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Woodsman enchanted by Agatha into the Wolf Knight.

entities.name: Syr Imodane
entities.description: Captured by Agatha, who prepared to cook her into a stew.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Slew Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron, then returned it to Talion.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Spell cast to end the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion ended by the Wicked Slumber.

events.summary: Talion gives the cauldron to Agatha in exchange for her and her sisters' help casting the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: It was originally owned by Talion , who gave it to Agatha

events.summary: Agatha enchants the woodsman Peter into the Wolf Knight and, with his help, captures Syr Imodane.
events.quote: she enchanted the woodsman Peter , turning him into the Wolf Knight

events.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and boiling her alive.
events.quote: Kellan slew the witch by pushing her into her cauldron and boiling her alive

events.summary: Kellan takes ownership of the cauldron and later returns it to Talion.
events.quote: Kellan took ownership of the Cauldron after that and later returned it to Talion.
